description:
Animate a still image into a video using AI.

WORKFLOW:
1. Provide the image EITHER as a public HTTPS URL (image_url) OR as a local file (image_path)
2. Call this tool with the image and a motion prompt → returns task_id
3. Wait 30 seconds, then call check_kling_task(task_id, task_type="image2video")
4. Repeat step 3 until status is "succeed" (typically 2-5 minutes)

IMAGE REQUIREMENTS:
- image_url: publicly accessible https:// URL, OR
- image_path: local file inside MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH (or the system temp directory). Formats: .jpg / .jpeg / .png, max 10MB. The file is Base64-encoded and sent directly — no hosting service needed.
- High resolution works best

callback_url.description: HTTPS URL that Kling POSTs the task result to when the task status changes. Optional — polling with check_kling_task works without it.

image_path.description: Absolute path to a local image file inside MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH (or the system temp directory). Formats: .jpg / .jpeg / .png, max 10MB. Provide either image_url or image_path, not both.

image_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the image to animate. Provide either image_url or image_path, not both.

negative_prompt.description: Motion to avoid: "jerky movement, face distortion, unnatural motion"

prompt.description: Describe the desired motion/animation: camera movement, subject movement.

name: generate_kling_image_to_video
